fact: Agence Ecofin reports the minister citing the Code du numérique, adopted in 2023, as the legal framework for several digital activities including data and electronic services.
ACP reports that the ministerial order of 11 March 2026 is made to implement the DRC Code du numérique of 2023, which the order treats as the operative law for digital services.

fact: ACP reports that the Minister of Digital Economy signed on 11 March 2026 an order, published 17 March 2026, setting conditions for authorising digital services, including prior authorisation of trust services (electronic signature, certification, time-stamping), with a transition to 30 June 2026.
The order is made under the Code du numérique (Ordonnance-loi 23/010 of 13 March 2023), citing its articles as the legal basis for the authorisation regime.
system: Ordonnance-loi n° 23/010 du 13 mars 2023 portant Code du Numérique

fact: The order of 11 March 2026 sets the authorisation regime for qualified trust-service providers (electronic signature, seal, time-stamp, archiving, certification, website authentication, registered delivery, cryptology), marketplaces and e-commerce platforms; it enters into force on signature, with full application from 1 July 2026.

The ordonnance-loi of 13 March 2023 (Code du Numérique) governs electronic writings, electronic signatures (qualified signature has the evidential force of a handwritten one, Art. 108), trust service providers and digital services; it is the instrument itself, dated 13 March 2023.
